originality.rationale: For products of at least three fields, Kiani–Maimani–Nikandish's Theorem 2.4 already gives gamma_t equal to the number r of maximal associated primes and constructs pairwise-zero annihilator witnesses, hence a minimum total-dominating clique. For the two-factor exceptional regime, their preceding remark gives gamma_t=2 when gamma=1, and the zero-divisor graph visibly contains a dominating edge. Therefore the claimed value 2 ceil(r/2) is a direct parity corollary of the existing total-domination result on precisely this object.
